2irBI1-wUSwavFrgqpj5_g.zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於9/17-23期間,WPV1 新增阿富汗7例;cVDPV2新增2國共4例,分別為剛果⺠主共和國3例、查德1例;環境樣本部分,WPV1新增巴基斯坦1件 。 巴基斯坦9/29報告新增1例WPV1病例,為17個月大的女嬰,居住於西北部開伯爾-普赫圖赫瓦省(KP)班努地區。此案為該國今年第5例病例,其中4例在班努地區發現,該國今年已啟動4次大規模疫苗接種運動。
2irBI1-wUSwavFrgqpj5_g.en: The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported that during 17–23 September, WPV1 added 7 cases in Afghanistan; cVDPV2 added 4 cases in 2 countries, 3 in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and 1 in Chad; and in environmental samples, WPV1 added 1 detection in Pakistan. On 29 September, Pakistan reported one new WPV1 case, a 17-month-old girl living in Bannu district of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa (KP) province in the north-west. This is the country's fifth case this year, 4 of which were found in Bannu district. The country has launched four mass vaccination campaigns this year.

U6KDJdnwBzrqnJZbLUeMvg.zh: WHO於今年5/14召開第45次IHR小兒麻痺症緊急委員會並於8/25公布決議,今年截至4/30全球累積報告16例WPV1病例、2 例cVDPV1病例、28例cVDPV2病例及2例cVDPV3病例。環境樣本部分:累計報告74件WPV1、27件cVDPV2。考量全球疫情傳播及疫苗覆蓋率,評估持續構成國際關注公共衛生緊急事件(PHEIC),並再延⻑臨時性措施3個月,惟不構成緊急大流行(Pandemic Emergency),並建議有11個國家(有WPV1、cVDPV1、cVDPV3傳播風險者)需加強疫情監測及疫苗接種等措施,包括有WPV1疫情之阿富汗、巴基斯坦、德國,有cVDPV1 疫情之阿爾及利亞、剛果⺠主共和國、吉布地、以色列、寮國,有cVDPV3疫情之喀麥隆、查德、奈及利亞;另建議24個有cVDPV2國內傳播風險的國家加強防治措施。由於核疫區的持續傳播、偏鄉與衝突地區疫苗接種覆蓋率不均以及頻繁的跨國人口流動,WPV1及cVDPV仍具有高度國際傳播風險 。 WHO於8/19宣布非洲5國cVDPV2疫情已終止,分別為蒲隆地 、迦納、幾內亞比索、剛果共和國及烏干達。當局近年透過資金與技術支援、加強疫苗接種,強化急性無力肢體麻痺監測與實驗室檢驗能力,以及應用地理資訊系統的成功阻斷疫情。
U6KDJdnwBzrqnJZbLUeMvg.en: WHO convened the 45th IHR Emergency Committee on polio on 14 May this year and published its decision on 25 August. As of 30 April this year, 16 WPV1 cases, 2 cVDPV1 cases, 28 cVDPV2 cases and 2 cVDPV3 cases had been reported worldwide. For environmental samples, 74 WPV1 and 27 cVDPV2 detections had been reported cumulatively. Considering global transmission and vaccination coverage, the committee assessed that polio continues to constitute a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC), extended temporary recommendations by 3 months, but does not constitute a Pandemic Emergency. It recommended that 11 countries at risk of WPV1, cVDPV1 or cVDPV3 transmission strengthen surveillance and vaccination: Afghanistan, Pakistan and Germany (WPV1 outbreaks); Algeria, the DRC, Djibouti, Israel and Laos (cVDPV1 outbreaks); and Cameroon, Chad and Nigeria (cVDPV3 outbreaks). It also recommended that 24 countries at risk of domestic cVDPV2 transmission strengthen control measures. Owing to continued transmission in endemic areas, uneven vaccination coverage in remote and conflict-affected areas, and frequent cross-border population movement, WPV1 and cVDPV remain at high risk of international spread. WHO declared on 19 August that cVDPV2 outbreaks had ended in five African countries: Burundi, Ghana, Guinea-Bissau, the Republic of the Congo and Uganda. In recent years, these outbreaks were stopped through financial and technical support, enhanced vaccination, strengthened acute flaccid paralysis surveillance and laboratory capacity, and the use of geographic information systems.

PAzKkyNn7SVY0QaKKuOSEQ.zh: WHO公布全球今年截至5月累計報告11萬4,829 例病例,其中1,318例死亡,5月新增病例數較今4月增加43%,惟較去年同期下降59%,各國致死率(CFR)介於0-11.6%。病例分布於東地中海、非洲、東南亞及美洲共 23 個國家,近期新增病例以阿富汗、奈及利亞、剛果⺠主共和國(DRC)為多,其中DRC寬果省(Kwango)於6月底爆發疫情,致死率(CFR)達7.4%,高於WHO的1%警戒閾。WHO 評估因受極端氣候與部分地區基礎衛生系統癱瘓影響,約有10 億人口面臨感染風險,全球傳播風險為非常高。
PAzKkyNn7SVY0QaKKuOSEQ.en: WHO reports that globally, 114,829 cases, including 1,318 deaths, were reported cumulatively through May this year. New cases in May rose 43% compared with April, but fell 59% compared with the same period last year. The case fatality ratio across countries ranges from 0 to 11.6%. Cases are distributed across 23 countries in the Eastern Mediterranean, African, South-East Asian and Americas Regions. Recently, new cases have been concentrated in Afghanistan, Nigeria and the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC). In the DRC, an outbreak in Kwango Province began at the end of June, with a case fatality ratio of 7.4%, above WHO's alert threshold of 1%. WHO assesses that, owing to extreme weather and the collapse of basic health systems in some areas, about 1 billion people face the risk of infection, and the global transmission risk is very high.

oATFeYMhl2DwqMB-OzBARg.zh: 菲律賓疫情下降,10/12-25報告14,038例病例,較9/28-10/11報告15,182例減少8%,惟當局表示颱風過後,仍存在疫情風險。 阿富汗自9月底以來疑病例數上升,今年共6省累計報告4,384例疑病例,其中楠哈爾省於11月第2週報告1,021例疑病例,較前1週948例增加7.7%。

A total of 4,384 suspected cases have been reported this year across six provinces. In Nangarhar province, 1,021 suspected cases were reported in the second week of November, up 7.7% from 948 the previous week.

ijG8mTyCHDhy1TRAA2bBfA.zh: WHO公布全球今年截至8月累計報告逾46萬例,近6,000例死亡,其中,8月新增報告逾5.7萬例,較7月下降16%,各國CFR介於0-9.8%;病例分布於非洲、東地中海、東南亞、美洲、西太平洋共32個國家/地區,以阿富汗、南蘇丹及葉門為多;WHO評估約有10億人口面臨感染風險,全球傳播風險為非常高。
ijG8mTyCHDhy1TRAA2bBfA.en: WHO reports that globally, as of August this year, more than 460,000 cases and nearly 6,000 deaths have been reported cumulatively. In August, more than 57,000 new cases were reported, 16% lower than in July, with national case fatality rates ranging from 0 to 9.8%. Cases have been distributed across 32 countries and areas in Africa, the Eastern Mediterranean, South-East Asia, the Americas and the Western Pacific, mainly in Afghanistan, South Sudan and Yemen. WHO assesses that about one billion people face the risk of infection, and the global transmission risk is very high.

g8I3gjnuCs8GJ-d8-dIeWA.zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於8/28-9/3期間,WPV1新增2國共4例,分別為巴基斯坦3例、阿富汗1例;cVDPV2新增4國共5例,分別為安哥拉2例、查德/奈及利亞/巴布亞紐幾內亞(前已掌握)各1例。
g8I3gjnuCs8GJ-d8-dIeWA.en: The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported that during 28 August–3 September, wild poliovirus type 1 (WPV1) increased by four cases in two countries: Pakistan (3) and Afghanistan (1). cVDPV2 increased by five cases in four countries: Angola (2), and Chad, Nigeria and Papua New Guinea (1 each; previously identified).

te-55ufcQ2ClxQUbcfUTeA.zh: WHO公布全球今年截至7月累計報告約38萬例,4,478例死亡,其中,7月新增報告約6.8萬例、死亡624例,較6月上升14%,各國CFR介於0-11.2%;病例分布於非洲、東地中海、東南亞及美洲共31個國家/地區,以南蘇丹、阿富汗、葉門及剛果民主共和國為多;WHO評估約有10億人口面臨感染風險,全球傳播風險為非常高。
te-55ufcQ2ClxQUbcfUTeA.en: WHO reports that globally, as of July this year, about 380,000 cases and 4,478 deaths have been cumulatively reported. In July alone, about 68,000 new cases and 624 deaths were reported, a 14% increase over June. Case fatality rates across countries range from 0–11.2%. Cases are distributed across 31 countries and regions in Africa, the Eastern Mediterranean, South-East Asia and the Americas, with the most in South Sudan, Afghanistan, Yemen and the Democratic Republic of the Congo. WHO estimates that about one billion people are at risk of infection, and assesses the global transmission risk as very high.

qi74zLQif9HAS6bGq6jkDQ.zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於7/31-8/6期間,WPV1新增巴基斯坦1例;cVDPV2新增2國共2例,分別為查德/奈及利亞各1例;環境樣本部分,WPV1新增阿富汗4件,cVDPV1新增以色列6件,cVDPV2新增德國8件。
qi74zLQif9HAS6bGq6jkDQ.en: The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported that during 31 July–6 August, WPV1 increased by one case in Pakistan. cVDPV2 increased by two cases in two countries, one each in Chad and Nigeria. For environmental samples, WPV1 increased by four samples in Afghanistan, cVDPV1 by six samples in Israel, and cVDPV2 by eight samples in Germany.

JJ420vWXagCIspeEq_2CuA.zh: WHO公布全球今年截至6月累計報告近30.6萬例,3,522例死亡,其中,6月新增報告約6.2萬例、死亡527例,較5月下降21%,各國CFR介於0-8.1%;病例分布於非洲、東地中海及東南亞共28個國家/地區,以南蘇丹、葉門、阿富汗、及剛果民主共和國為多;目前全球口服霍亂疫苗緊急應變庫存290萬劑,低於安全水平(500萬劑),估計約有10億人口面臨感染風險,評估全球傳播風險為非常高。
JJ420vWXagCIspeEq_2CuA.en: WHO reports that as of June this year, nearly 306,000 cases and 3,522 deaths have been reported globally. In June alone, about 62,000 new cases and 527 deaths were reported, a 21% decrease from May. Case fatality ratios range from 0 to 8.1% across countries. Cases were distributed across 28 countries and territories in Africa, the Eastern Mediterranean and South-East Asia, with the most in South Sudan, Yemen, Afghanistan and the Democratic Republic of the Congo. The global emergency stockpile of oral cholera vaccine currently stands at 2.9 million doses, below the safe threshold of 5 million doses. An estimated 1 billion people face a risk of infection, and WHO assesses the global transmission risk as very high.

HDUdgM7O3CKOUbza69lsFA.zh: WHO公布全球今年截至4月累計報告已達157,035例,2,148例死亡,其中,4月報告逾3.7萬例病例(死亡561例),較今年3月增加5%,各國CFR介於0-5.3%;病例分布於非洲、東地中海及東南亞共18個國家/地區,以阿富汗、南蘇丹及剛果民主共和國為多,目前全球口服霍亂疫苗緊急應變庫存360萬劑,低於安全水平(500萬劑),估計約有10億人口面臨感染風險,評估全球傳播風險為非常高。
HDUdgM7O3CKOUbza69lsFA.en: WHO reports that as of April this year, 157,035 cases and 2,148 deaths have been reported cumulatively worldwide. In April alone, more than 37,000 cases (561 deaths) were reported, a 5% increase from March this year, with CFRs between 0 and 5.3% across countries. Cases are distributed across 18 countries and regions in Africa, the Eastern Mediterranean and South-East Asia, mainly in Afghanistan, South Sudan and the Democratic Republic of the Congo. The global emergency stockpile of oral cholera vaccine currently stands at 3.6 million doses, below the safety level of 5 million doses. An estimated 1 billion people face a risk of infection. The global transmission risk is assessed as very high.

1kovSZBbxd8mSzsk34XkiA.zh: 北美洲疫情更新,美國今年截至5/22報告14起疫情,累計31州1,046例,其中127例住院及3例死亡,以德州逾700例為多,惟近期疫情已趨緩,然其他州仍持續報告零星病例,愛荷華州及內布拉斯加州報告今年首例;加拿大今年截至5/17共9省2,515例,以安大略省(1,848)為多,其次為亞伯達省(509),近期中部曼托巴省/薩斯喀徹溫省病例數亦快速增加,預估疫情將持續至夏季。 阿富汗疫情嚴峻,今年迄今報告5.5萬餘例及357例死亡(CFR : 0.6%),自年初以來病例數呈穩定上升趨勢,於第16週達最高峰,疫情高於前3年(2022-24年)平均,發病率以該國南部赫爾曼德省最高,由於該國政局不穩及醫療基礎設施不足,嚴重影響疫苗接種及疫情控制等措施之推動。
1kovSZBbxd8mSzsk34XkiA.en: North America update: as of 22 May this year, the United States has reported 14 outbreaks, with 1,046 cases cumulatively across 31 states, including 127 hospitalizations and 3 deaths. Texas has the most, with over 700 cases. Although the outbreak in Texas has recently slowed, other states continue to report sporadic cases, and Iowa and Nebraska reported their first cases this year. As of 17 May, Canada had 2,515 cases across 9 provinces this year, mainly in Ontario (1,848), followed by Alberta (509). Case numbers have also risen rapidly recently in the central provinces of Manitoba and Saskatchewan, and the outbreak is expected to continue into the summer. Afghanistan's outbreak is severe: this year more than 55,000 cases and 357 deaths (CFR 0.6%) have been reported. Cases have risen steadily since the beginning of the year and peaked in week 16, higher than the average for the previous three years (2022–24). Incidence is highest in Helmand Province in the south of the country. Political instability and insufficient medical infrastructure have seriously hampered vaccination and outbreak control efforts.

kY4peGDHORIBotL0ZEMU2w.zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於4/1-5/7期間, cVDPV2型新增查德1例,cVDPV3新增幾內亞1例。環境樣本部分,WPV1型陽性樣本新增阿富汗7件,cVDPV2陽性樣本新增3國共3件,分別為喀麥隆、中非共和國、吉布地各1件。
kY4peGDHORIBotL0ZEMU2w.en: The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported that between 1 April and 7 May, cVDPV2 cases increased by 1 in Chad, and cVDPV3 cases by 1 in Guinea. For environmental samples, WPV1-positive samples increased by 7 in Afghanistan, and cVDPV2-positive samples increased by 3 across 3 countries: 1 each in Cameroon, the Central African Republic and Djibouti.

xxkSS0JphoLy4e2m9TmnZQ.zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於4/17-23期間,WPV1型新增阿富汗1例,cVDPV2型新增2國共4例,分別為衣索比亞3例、奈及利亞1例。環境樣本部分,WPV1型陽性樣本新增阿富汗1件。
xxkSS0JphoLy4e2m9TmnZQ.en: The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported that between 17 and 23 April, one new WPV1 case was reported in Afghanistan, and cVDPV2 cases increased by 4 in 2 countries: 3 in Ethiopia and 1 in Nigeria. For environmental samples, one new WPV1-positive sample was reported in Afghanistan.

9EW7rYzI9WlgEJDXbGbiXQ.zh: WHO於4/22公布全球今年迄3月累計報告11萬6,574例病例,1,514例死亡,其中,3月份報告近3萬3,000例病例,517例死亡(CFR:1.6%),較2月病例/死亡數分別下降9%及8%。病患分布於非洲、東地中海及東南亞區域共22個國家,新增病例數以南蘇丹(7,709例)、阿富汗(7,130例)及剛果民主共和國(5,679例)等為多,WHO評估全球傳播風險為非常高。
9EW7rYzI9WlgEJDXbGbiXQ.en: WHO reported on 22 April that globally, as of March this year, 116,574 cases and 1,514 deaths had been reported cumulatively. In March alone, nearly 33,000 cases and 517 deaths were reported (CFR 1.6%), a decrease of 9% in cases and 8% in deaths compared with February. Cases are distributed across 22 countries in Africa, the Eastern Mediterranean and South-East Asia. The largest numbers of new cases were in South Sudan (7,709), Afghanistan (7,130) and the Democratic Republic of the Congo (5,679). WHO assesses the global transmission risk as very high.

btDWctmTozdbv0jSagVO7Q.zh: 阿富汗報告去年該國全年累計報告14省1,221例疑病例、其中95例死亡(CFR:7.8%),採檢844例疑病例,其中271例為陽性(陽性率:32.1%)。另該國前年(2023年)全年累計1,236例疑病例、其中114例死亡(CFR:9.2%)。
btDWctmTozdbv0jSagVO7Q.en: Afghanistan reported that last year, 1,221 suspected cases were recorded cumulatively in 14 provinces, of which 95 died (CFR: 7.8%). Of 844 suspected cases tested, 271 were positive (positivity: 32.1%). In 2023, the country recorded 1,236 suspected cases cumulatively, of which 114 died (CFR: 9.2%).

xy7lWioReq0doO0YEjOHRw.zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於2/13-19期間,WPV1型新增報告2國3例,分別為巴基斯坦2例、阿富汗1例;cVDPV2型新增報告阿爾及利亞1例病例;cVDPV3型新增報告幾內亞1例病例。環境樣本部分,WPV1型陽性樣本新增巴基斯坦/阿富汗各9件;cVDPV2型陽性樣本,新增巴勒斯坦3件、阿爾及利亞1件。
xy7lWioReq0doO0YEjOHRw.en: The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported that between 13 and 19 February, WPV1 cases were newly reported in 2 countries: 3 cases, 2 in Pakistan and 1 in Afghanistan. One new cVDPV2 case was reported in Algeria, and one new cVDPV3 case in Guinea. For environmental samples, 9 new WPV1-positive samples were reported in each of Pakistan and Afghanistan. For cVDPV2-positive samples, 3 new samples were reported in Palestine and 1 in Algeria.

fRaoLwShbPw4wdRAuvl14w.zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於 11/28-12/4期間,共2國新增3例WPV1病例,分別為阿富汗2例、巴基斯坦1例;日新增3例cVDPV2病例。環境樣本部分,巴基斯坦新增16件WPV1陽性樣本;共2國新增5件cVDPV2陽性樣本,分別為德國4件、日1件。 芬蘭於12/9公布於11月自該國西南部坦佩雷地區監測到cVDPV2陽性樣本,目前尚無報告病例,當局表示目前該國疫苗接種覆蓋率為非常高(98%),該國為近期歐洲第4個檢出cVDPV2陽性樣本之國家。
fRaoLwShbPw4wdRAuvl14w.en: The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported that during 28 November–4 December, three new WPV1 cases were reported in two countries: two in Afghanistan and one in Pakistan. Niger reported three new cVDPV2 cases. For environmental samples, Pakistan reported 16 new WPV1-positive samples, and two countries reported five new cVDPV2-positive samples: four in Germany and one in Niger. On 9 December, Finland reported cVDPV2-positive samples collected in November from the Tampere region in the south-west of the country; no cases have been reported. Authorities state that the country's vaccination coverage is very high, at 98%. Finland is the fourth European country recently to detect cVDPV2-positive samples.

NdTbNjqsO2mpAriVJxOaMw.zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於 11/14-11/20期間,巴基斯坦新增1例WPV1病例;共2國新增6例cVDPV2病例,其中查德5例、奈及利亞1例。環境樣本部分,共2國新增7件WPV1陽性樣本,分別為阿富汗6件、巴基斯坦1件;共3國新增3件cVDPV2陽性樣本,分別為查德/波蘭/南蘇丹各1件。 波蘭於11/18報告該國檢出cVDPV2陽性樣本,係自該國首都華沙10/22之廢水樣本中檢出,當地迄無報告病例。經分析顯示,該病毒與奈及利亞北部疫情相關,近期亦於西班牙被檢測到。
NdTbNjqsO2mpAriVJxOaMw.en:
The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported that between 14 and 20 November, Pakistan added 1 WPV1 case. A total of 2 countries added 6 cVDPV2 cases: Chad 5 and Nigeria 1. For environmental samples, 2 countries added 7 WPV1-positive samples: Afghanistan 6 and Pakistan 1. A total of 3 countries added 3 cVDPV2-positive samples: Chad, Poland and South Sudan, 1 each.

Poland reported on 18 November that cVDPV2-positive samples had been detected in the country, from wastewater samples collected in the capital, Warsaw, on 22 October. No cases have been reported locally. Analysis shows that the virus is related to the outbreak in northern Nigeria, and it has also recently been detected in Spain.

yfYSgiBBBmPA7Ey6MbHpyA.zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於 10/24-10/30期間,巴基斯坦新增2例WPV1病例;查德新增2例cVDPV2病例;幾內亞新增3例cVDPV3病例。環境樣本部分,阿富汗新增1件WPV1陽性樣本;共4國新增4件cVDPV2陽性樣本,分別為喀麥隆/幾內亞/日/塞內加爾各1件。 西班牙於10/3報告該國首件cVDPV2陽性樣本,該樣本於9月中旬自該國東北部加泰隆亞廢水樣本中檢出,當地迄無報告病例,當地疫苗覆蓋率逾92%,評估對公眾健康影響有限。 法屬圭亞那於10/14首次檢出cVDPV3陽性樣本,樣本採集自首府開雲(Cayenne),目前尚無報告病例。
yfYSgiBBBmPA7Ey6MbHpyA.en:
The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported that between 24 and 30 October, Pakistan added 2 WPV1 cases, Chad added 2 cVDPV2 cases and Guinea added 3 cVDPV3 cases. For environmental samples, Afghanistan added 1 WPV1-positive sample; a total of 4 countries added 4 cVDPV2-positive samples, one each in Cameroon, Guinea, Niger and Senegal.

Spain reported on 3 October its first cVDPV2-positive sample, detected in mid-September in wastewater from Catalonia in northeastern Spain. No cases have been reported locally, local vaccination coverage exceeds 92%, and the impact on public health is assessed as limited.

French Guiana detected its first cVDPV3-positive sample on 14 October. The sample was collected in the capital, Cayenne. No cases have been reported so far.

LetmbIJE6lrOylghYlpDKg.zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於10/17-10/23期間,共2國新增8例WPV1病例,分別為巴基斯坦7例、阿富汗1例;共3國新增9例cVDPV2病例,分別為奈及利亞5例、查德3例、日1例。環境樣本部分,共2國新增11件WPV1陽性樣本,分別為阿富汗10件、巴基斯坦1件;共3國新增4件cVDPV2陽性樣本,分別為查德2件、吉布地/日各1件。
LetmbIJE6lrOylghYlpDKg.en: The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported that between 17 and 23 October, a total of 2 countries added 8 WPV1 cases: Pakistan 7 and Afghanistan 1. A total of 3 countries added 9 cVDPV2 cases: Nigeria 5, Chad 3 and Niger 1. For environmental samples, 2 countries added 11 WPV1-positive samples: Afghanistan 10 and Pakistan 1. A total of 3 countries added 4 cVDPV2-positive samples: Chad 2, and Djibouti and Niger 1 each.

unoWzrixICQQwjn7hG4dqw.zh: 全球疫情更新,今年迄今累計超過1,300萬例病例及8,500例死亡:  美洲區病例數以巴西為多,其次為阿根廷、墨西哥、巴拉圭、哥倫比亞; 歐洲區法國、義大利、西班牙有報告病例; 東地中海區伊朗、阿富汗、巴基斯坦有報告病例; 東南亞區孟加拉及泊爾病例數上升,印度喀拉拉邦及卡納塔卡邦今年病例數高於去年同期,印病例數下降; 西太平洋區中國及越南病例數上升,柬埔寨病例數下降; 非洲區中非共和國於9月中公布爆發疫情,多哥疫情亦上升。
unoWzrixICQQwjn7hG4dqw.en:
Global update: So far this year, more than 13 million cases and 8,500 deaths have been cumulatively reported globally.

Americas: Case numbers are highest in Brazil, followed by Argentina, Mexico, Paraguay and Colombia.

Europe: France, Italy and Spain have reported cases.

Eastern Mediterranean: Iran, Afghanistan and Pakistan have reported cases.

South-East Asia: Case numbers rose in Bangladesh and Nepal. In the Indian states of Kerala and Karnataka, cases this year are higher than in the same period last year. Case numbers in Indonesia declined.

Western Pacific: Case numbers rose in China and Viet Nam and fell in Cambodia.

Africa: The Central African Republic announced an outbreak in mid-September, and cases in Togo also rose.

RAZen0Fms8bDx5DZg8eh3g.zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於10/3-10/9期間,巴基斯坦新增4例WPV1病例;共3國新增6例cVDPV2病例,分別為奈及利亞4例、安哥拉/南蘇丹各1例。環境樣本部分,巴基斯坦新增50件WPV1陽性樣本;共4國新增8件cVDPV2陽性樣本,分別為日4件、南蘇丹2件、西班牙/葉門各1件;法屬圭亞那新增3件cVDPV3陽性樣本。 全球今年WPV1病例累計50例,其中巴基斯坦28例、阿富汗22例,疾病仍持續傳播並造成兒童健康風險。
RAZen0Fms8bDx5DZg8eh3g.en: The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported that between 3 and 9 October, Pakistan recorded 4 new WPV1 cases. Across 3 countries, 6 new cVDPV2 cases were reported: Nigeria 4, and Angola and South Sudan 1 each. For environmental samples, Pakistan recorded 50 new WPV1-positive samples. Across 4 countries, 8 new cVDPV2-positive samples were reported: Japan 4, South Sudan 2, and Spain and Yemen 1 each. French Guiana recorded 3 new cVDPV3-positive samples. Globally this year, cumulative WPV1 cases total 50, including 28 in Pakistan and 22 in Afghanistan. The disease continues to spread and poses health risks to children.

57bxX2w6fSqeGz7AKTRkUQ.zh: 據報載,阿富汗近期爆發不明原因疾病,累計報告逾500例病例,其中2例死亡,病患出現虛弱、四肢疼痛、嚴重腹瀉、高燒等類傷寒症狀。泰國衛生當局10/9宣布針對來自阿富汗旅客加強入境篩檢,並呼籲民眾前往高風險國家前先行接種傷寒疫苗。
57bxX2w6fSqeGz7AKTRkUQ.en: Media reports indicate that an unexplained illness has recently broken out in Afghanistan, with over 500 cases reported cumulatively, including 2 deaths.
